description: Caltrans GIS Data hub is an open data portal listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by California Department of Transportation (Caltrans). Caltrans publishes the state highway system, bridges, traffic counts, rail, transit and related planning layers as open geospatial datasets with ArcGIS feature services and downloads. Coverage: California, United States. The catalogue lists 83 datasets, each with its own page, description and export options. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network and hazard studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
